answer: Bind each earning key to one aged public social account. Once, the agent's owner posts a cipher (hash of the poa1 address plus the epoch beacon) from an account at least 365 days old with 50+ mutual follows; one account per key, forever. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 aged accounts (~$10 each on gray markets, ~$10,000), and a nebula of bought profiles clusters by follow overlap: keys whose accounts share over 30% of mutuals merge into one payout. Writing a sonnet is cheap; faking a year of real friendships isn't.
